description: This file defines a PHP class ReviewerDecorator within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the HRM Performance Plugin, responsible for providing a decorator pattern around the Reviewer entity, with methods to manipulate reviewer data, including setting associated employees.

classes.name: ReviewerDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Reviewer entity, providing additional methods and accessors for reviewer data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a Reviewer object.

methods.name: getReviewer
methods.description: Returns the Reviewer object being decorated.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee for the reviewer based on employee number, retrieving the Employee entity via a reference method.
